# Staging terms, 2026 fair

Craft section exhibitors pay a 20% staging levy on the amount they owe after
refunds. Sections Food, Plants and Textiles carry no levy.

One row per exhibitor. The refund column is money already paid back to the
exhibitor after the marquee relayout, written as a positive amount.
